-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
  match k with
  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")

def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
  match name, args with
  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_path_length", [x] => q (kin_path_length s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_gear", [x] => qz (kin_gear s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_throttle", [x] => q (kin_throttle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_service_brake", [x] => q (kin_service_brake s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_occupant_count", [x] => qn (ru_occupant_count s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", [x] => qn (ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
    | .s "count" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "adjacency field")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_adjacency_count", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_width", [r] => q (st_lane_width s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_curvature", [r] => q (st_curvature s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_grade", [r] => q (st_grade s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_distance", [r] => q (st_sight_distance s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_along_way", [x, w] => q (st_sight_along_way s (← ent x) (← ent w)) name
  | "st_parking_space_angle", [r] => q (st_parking_space_angle s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_region_geometry", [r, k] => comp (st_region_geometry_position s (← ent r)) k name
  | "st_region_geometry_distance", [x, r] => q (st_region_geometry_distance s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name
  | "dev_position", [d, k] => comp (dev_position s (← ent d)) k name
  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", [d] => q (dev_speed_limit_sign_value s (← ent d)) name
  | "env_visibility", [] => q (env_visibility s) name
  | "env_civil_time", [k] =>
    let ct := env_civil_time s
    match k with
    | .s "minute_of_day" => qn (ct.map (·.minuteOfDay)) name
    | .s "weekday" => qn (ct.map (·.weekday)) name
    | .s "month" => qn (ct.map (·.month)) name
    | .s "day" => qn (ct.map (·.day)) name
    | .s "year" => qn (ct.map (·.year)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "civil time field")
  | "rel_centre_distance", [a, a'] => q (rel_centre_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a'] => q (rel_surface_gap_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a', k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "longitudinal" => q (rel_surface_gap_longitudinal s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | .s "lateral" => q (rel_surface_gap_lateral s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "gap component")
  | "rel_longitudinal_overlap", [a, a'] => q (rel_longitudinal_overlap s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_bearing", [a, a', k] => comp (rel_bearing s (← ent a) (← ent a')) k name
  | n, _ => if measureNames.contains n then .error (arity n) else .error (unknownAtom n)
where
  measureNames : List String := [
    "kin_time", "kin_position", "kin_heading", "kin_velocity", "kin_speed", "kin_accel_longitudinal",
    "kin_yaw_rate", "kin_extent", "kin_steer_angle", "kin_path_length", "kin_gear", "kin_throttle", "kin_service_brake", "ru_occupant_count",
    "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", "ru_electric_bicycle_class", "st_lane_direction", "st_lane_adjacency",
    "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", "st_lane_adjacency_count", "st_lane_width", "st_curvature", "st_grade",
    "st_sight_distance", "st_sight_along_way", "st_parking_space_angle", "st_region_geometry", "st_region_geometry_distance",
    "dev_position", "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", "env_visibility", "env_civil_time",
    "rel_centre_distance", "rel_surface_gap", "rel_longitudinal_overlap", "rel_bearing"]

/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
  match name with
  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
  | n =>
    if !knowsAtom n then none
    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
    else none

/-- The Lean name of an ATOMS.md id or attribute path (`dev.traffic_signal.shows` ↦ `dev_traffic_signal_shows`). -/
def defName (id : String) : String := id.replace "." "_"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The evaluator: every subformula once, over the whole trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
  | _ => false

/-- The single value of a constant term's per-instant array. -/
def constOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q := do
  if !Term.isConstant t then throw (.malformed "parameter is not a constant term")
  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

/-- The value of a heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, read as `constOf`
    reads a constant; any other term is malformed. -/
def stepOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q :=
  match t with
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)
  | _ => .error (.malformed "heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter")

/-- The subject variable of a window: needed for path windows, irrelevant for time windows. -/
def subjectFor (β : Binding) (m : Measure) (v : String) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match m with
  | .time => .ok 0
  | .path => match β.track v with | some t => .ok t | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)

/-- Every region a quantifier over a kind ranges over in some scene of the trace: those whose
    membership of the kind is not false there (`regionCandidates`). -/
def regionsOf (c : SemCtx) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => regionCandidates s k).eraseDups
def devicesOf (c : SemCtx) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => deviceCandidates s k).eraseDups
/-- At each instant, whether the region is of the kind: true, false, or unknown where the source
    cannot tell the kind. A quantifier conjoins it with its body, so a region the source cannot
    place in the kind makes the quantifier unknown, never decided by its absence. -/
def regionIsKind (c : SemCtx) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (isKind s r k) (.absentAtom s!"st_{k}")
def deviceIsKind (c : SemCtx) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (devKind s d k) (.absentAtom s!"dev_{k}")
/-- Every road user present in some scene of the trace. -/
def usersOf (c : SemCtx) : List TrackId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups

/-- The kind a quantifier ranges over: a spelling of the ontology. A variable here is a concept's
    literal formal that no expansion filled. -/
def regionKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason StructureKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match StructureKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"region kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"region kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "region kind")
def deviceKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason DeviceKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match DeviceKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"device kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"device kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "device kind")

/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
    it is unknown. -/
def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
  match pre.v with
  | .t => x
  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
  match g.v with
  | .t => a
  | .f => b
  | .u => match a, b with
    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
  | none =>
    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
    match op with
    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
    | _ => do
      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
      else
        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
        match op with
        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
  | some true => R.t
  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
  | some false =>
    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
    | some false => R.f
    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
    let s := c.scenes[i]!
    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

mutual
  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
    | .measure a args =>
      match resolveAll c.β args with
      | .error w => constE c.n w
      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      liftQ c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => liftQ c.n do
          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
        let s := c.scenes[i]!
        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
        let d ← y
        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
    | .cond φ a b' =>
      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
    | [] => .ok []
    | t :: rest => do
      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
    | .tt => const c.n R.t
    | .ff => const c.n R.f
    | .atom name args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
          pure (match ds with
            | [.v t, .s id] =>
              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
              | none =>
                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
    | .intent id who target =>
      match who, target with
      | .var a, .var b =>
        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
    | .same a b =>
      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
    | .and φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .or φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .within m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
        | .error w => R.u w
        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .rule id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .ruleApplies id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .existsUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
    | .forallUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every formula and every term has exactly one value per observation of the trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftA; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constU n w
private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftQ; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constE n w
private theorem size_qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : (qzip f a b).size = min a.size b.size := by
  simp [qzip]
private theorem size_perScene (c : SemCtx) (ev : List (Nat × Array R)) (p : Scene → Nat → Bool)
    (agg : List R → R) : (perScene c ev p agg).size = c.n := by simp [perScene]

mutual
  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .quantity _ args ps => by
        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .distanceWhile s φ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>
            try contradiction
          cases h; rw [Primitives.size_headingSince]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .neg a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  theorem size_evalAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ φ : Formula, (evalAll c φ).size = c.n
    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .atom name args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        split at h
        · cases h; split
          · split
            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
            · split
              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
              · simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
          · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
        · cases h; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .cmp l _ r => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c l, size_evalTAll c r, Nat.min_self]
    | .asm _ => by rw [evalAll]; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .intent _ who target => by
        cases who <;> cases target <;> rw [evalAll] <;> (repeat' split) <;>
          simp [size_constU, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .same a b => by
        rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp [size_constU, Temporal.size_const]
    | .not φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_mapNot]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .and φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipAnd, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .or φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipOr, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .implies φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipImplies, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .always φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_alwaysAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .eventually φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_eventuallyAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .until φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_untilAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .since φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_sinceAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .holdsFor m d s φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_holdsForAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .within m d s φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_withinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_untilWithinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_atLastAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .count edge sφ _ _ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_map, Temporal.size_countEdgesAll]; exact size_evalAll c edge
    | .rises φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_risesAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .definedWhen pre φ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalAll c pre, size_evalAll c φ, Nat.min_self]
    | .derived _ args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalB _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .rule _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
    | .ruleApplies _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
    | .existsUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .existsRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .existsDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unfolding lemmas: the connectives are the pointwise three-valued operations of Unknown.lean.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lemmas
variable (c : SemCtx) (φ ψ : Formula)

theorem evalAll_tt : evalAll c .tt = const c.n R.t := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_ff : evalAll c .ff = const c.n R.f := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_not : evalAll c (.not φ) = (evalAll c φ).map R.not := by rw [evalAll]; rfl
private theorem and_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.and a b = R.f := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]
private theorem or_of_t (a b : R) (h : a.v = .t) : R.or a b = R.t := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.or, R.settle, Tri.or, R.t]
private theorem implies_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.implies a b = R.t := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.implies, R.not, R.or, R.settle, Tri.not, Tri.or, R.t]

/-- A connective is the pointwise three-valued operation of its operands' arrays, whether or not
    its right operand was evaluated: where the left one settles it at every instant, both arrays
    have one value per observation and every pointwise value is the settled one. -/
theorem evalAll_and : evalAll c (.and φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.and (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [and_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_or : evalAll c (.or φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.or (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [or_of_t _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_implies : evalAll c (.implies φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.implies (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [implies_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_always : evalAll c (.always φ) = alwaysAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_eventually : evalAll c (.eventually φ) = eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_until : evalAll c (.until φ ψ) = untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_since : evalAll c (.since φ ψ) = sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β false).size = c.n) :
    evalAll c (.rule id map) = c.compose id map c.β false := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
theorem evalAll_ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β true).size = c.n) :
    evalAll c (.ruleApplies id map) = c.compose id map c.β true := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]

/-- The heading-change term is the accumulation operator over its onset's values. -/
theorem evalTAll_headingSince (s : String) (g : Term) (x : TrackId) (gv : Q)
    (hx : c.β.track s = some x) (hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) = .ok gv) :
    evalTAll c (.headingSince s g ψ) = Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalTAll]; simp only [hx, hg, liftQ, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]
/-- Unknown is absorbing for `not`, pointwise. -/
theorem eval_not_u (i : Nat) (h : (eval c i φ).v = .u) (hi : i < (evalAll c φ).size) : (eval c i (.not φ)).v = .u := by
  unfold eval at *
  rw [evalAll_not, Array.getElem?_map]
  simp only [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, R.not_v] at *
  rw [h]; rfl
end Lemmas

end Semantics
end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
3	  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
4	  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.
5	
6	  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
7	  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
8	  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.
9	
10	  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
11	  writes through a `Units` constructor.
12	-/
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Build
17	
18	/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
19	def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
20	def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
21	def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
22	def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))
23	
24	def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)
25	
26	/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
27	    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
28	def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
29	    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
30	  { track := track
31	    classes := some classes
32	    kin := { position := some pos
33	             heading := some heading
34	             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
35	             speed := some speed
36	             extent := some halfExtent
37	             pathLength := pathLength } }
38	
39	/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
40	def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
41	  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }
42	
43	def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
44	def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
45	/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
46	def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
47	def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }
48	
49	/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
50	def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
51	  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
52	/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
53	def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
54	  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
55	/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
56	def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
57	    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
58	    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
59	  { id := id
60	    kind := .lane
61	    boundary := some boundary
62	    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
63	                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
64	                   entersIntersection := enters } }
65	def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
66	  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }
67	
68	def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
69	  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
70	def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
71	  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
72	def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
73	def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
74	  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
75	def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
76	    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=

78	
79	/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
80	def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
81	  users.flatMap fun u =>
82	    match u.kin.position with
83	    | none => []
84	    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
85	      match st.boundary with
86	      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
87	      | none => none

89	/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
90	def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
91	    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
92	    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
93	  { t := t

96	    structures := structures
97	    devices := devices
98	    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
99	    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)

105	def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=

118	    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat

120	    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }

122	  | _, _ => τ

125	
126	/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
127	def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
128	  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
129	  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }
130	
131	end Build
132

134	    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
135	    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
136	    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
137	    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
138	    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
139	    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
140	    far enough to decide it. -/

142	  name : String
143	  rule : String
144	  trace : Trace
145	  reading : Reading
146	  manifest : Manifest
147	  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
148	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace

157	def pastOps : List String :=

159	   "heading_since"]

167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
168	    `unknown` witness only.

170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

/-

  - One lane eastward, y from 0 m to 4 m, x from -100 m to 300 m, count 1 in its direction

  - Subject car (track 1): heading east, 10 m/s, half extents 2 m × 1 m; x = 5·k m.
  - Overtaken rider (track 2): heading east, 6 m/s, half extents 1 m × 0.3 m, y = 1 m; x = 3·k + 8 m.
  - Samples every 0.5 s, k = 0 … 9, from t = 20 s. The rider's offset ahead of the car is 8 − 2k m:
    ahead with a gap between the projections at k ≤ 2 (8, 6, 4 m), side by side at k = 3, 4, 5
    (2, 0, −2 m), behind at k ≥ 6: the pass is recognized at k = 6 (t = 23 s).
  - The trace is padded 12 s before (the first scene repeated) so the 10 s window behind every judged
    instant is covered, and each witness judges the unpadded instants only (`window`).
  - Car's lateral position (y of its centre) sets the body-to-body gap while side by side:
    gap = y_car − 1 m − 1.3 m. forbid / blind 2.8 m → 0.5 m (below 3 ft = 0.9144 m);
    permit 3.8 m → 1.5 m (above 3 ft and above the reading's 1.0 m clearance);
    branch_3 3.25 m → 0.95 m (above 3 ft, below the reading's 1.0 m clearance).

  - idle: the overtaken vehicle is a moped (see the comment at idleTrace).
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_270_2b_o2
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_270_2b_o2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

def t0 : Timestamp := 20000
def nSteps : Nat := 10
def judged : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (20000, 24500)

/-- One eastward lane, the only one in its direction. -/
def oneLaneRoad : List Structure :=
  [ Build.lane 10 [(m (-100), m 0), (m 300, m 0), (m 300, m 4), (m (-100), m 4)] Build.east
      none none (some 1) (some 1) ]

/-- Two eastward lanes: the rider's (right, ordinal 2) and one to its left (ordinal 1). -/
def twoLaneRoad : List Structure :=
  [ Build.lane 10 [(m (-100), m 0), (m 300, m 0), (m 300, m 4), (m (-100), m 4)] Build.east
      (some 11) none (some 2) (some 2)
  , Build.lane 11 [(m (-100), m 4), (m 300, m 4), (m 300, m 8), (m (-100), m 8)] Build.east
      none (some 10) (some 1) (some 2) ]

def car (k : Nat) (y : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (m (5 * (k : Int)), y) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 10)
    (m 2, m 1, cm 75)

def rider (k : Nat) (cls : RoadUserClass) (y : Q) : RoadUser :=

    (Units.seconds 12) (Units.seconds 1) (Units.milliseconds 500)

def forbidTrace : Trace := passTrace .bicycle (cm 280) (m 1) oneLaneRoad

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same pass, the subject car keeping a gap above both 3 feet and the safe-gap clearance while side by side, the bicycle on its right. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := passTrace .bicycle (cm 380) (m 1) oneLaneRoad

    electric bicycle or electric scooter is in the scene. The overtaken vehicle is a moped: under the
    run's reading a car (`motor_vehicle`) is an unresolved class of the electric-bicycle and
    electric-scooter aggregates, so its membership is unknown, never decidedly false; a moped is
    excluded from all three. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := passTrace .moped (cm 380) (m 1) oneLaneRoad

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the source does not observe the gap between bodies. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := passTrace .bicycle (cm 280) (m 1) oneLaneRoad

/-- `branch_1` (violated): The subject car overtakes a rider on the rider's right, with a wide gap:
    while side by side the rider lies on the subject's left. The rider is an electric bicycle: under
    the run's reading the electric-scooter aggregate includes no class (`electric_scooter` is
    unresolved), so an electric scooter's membership is unknown and the pass could not be decided. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := passTrace .electricBicycle (cm 50) (cm 350) oneLaneRoad

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): The road has two lanes in the subject's direction; the subject passes a bicycle. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace := passTrace .bicycle (cm 380) (m 1) twoLaneRoad

/-- `branch_3` (violated): one lane; the car passes the bicycle on its left with a gap of 0.95 m:
    above the stated 3 feet but below the reading's clearance, the larger of the two. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := passTrace .bicycle (cm 325) (m 1) oneLaneRoad

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_270_2b_o2"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := judged
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["rel.surface_gap"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .violated ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_270_2b_o2

let u ← unit h
  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!

1	/-
2	  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.

5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Manifest
7	  What a source can observe: a capability per atom id, complete over ATOMS.md (`subject` is an atom
8	  observed for the subject track alone, as an instrumented vehicle reports its own controls); a mask
9	  that blanks every field of an absent atom, and of a subject-only atom on every other road user,
10	  before evaluation; and `support`, the first and most honest number
11	  a source gets — which rules it can be judged against at all, computed from the rules' syntax
12	  before any frame is read.
13	
14	  The same rules run on a simulator, on an annotated dataset and on perception over video; the
15	  only thing that differs is what each can see, and that difference is a declared input here.
16	  For the perception stage the manifest is the interface the other way round: the list of atoms
17	  its programs must deliver, with the error class each is allowed.
18	-/
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Ontology.Ids
22	
23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	
25	inductive Capability
26	  | exact
27	  | estimate (errorClass : String)
28	  | absent
29	  | subject
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	structure Manifest where
33	  source : String
34	  entries : List (String × Capability)     -- atom id in ATOMS.md form ↦ capability
35	  /-- The longest tracker break the source's re-identification links may bridge (seconds). -/
36	  reidGap : Q := Q.zero
37	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
38	
39	namespace Manifest
40	/-- An atom the manifest does not list is absent: silence is not a capability. -/
41	def capability (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Capability :=
42	  ((m.entries.find? (·.1 == id)).map (·.2)).getD .absent
43	def observes (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Bool := m.capability id != .absent
44	/-- Complete: every atom id of ATOMS.md has an entry, and no entry names anything else. -/
45	def complete (m : Manifest) : Bool :=
46	  atomIds.all (fun id => (m.entries.find? (·.1 == id)).isSome) &&
47	  m.entries.all (fun e => atomIds.contains e.1)
48	def absentIds (m : Manifest) : List String := atomIds.filter fun id => !m.observes id
49	/-- The atoms observed for the subject track only. -/
50	def subjectIds (m : Manifest) : List String := atomIds.filter fun id => m.capability id == .subject
51	/-- A manifest that observes everything exactly (the simulator's, and the tests'). -/
52	def full (source : String) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
53	  { source := source, entries := atomIds.map fun id => (id, .exact), reidGap := gap }
54	end Manifest
55	
56	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	-- From Lean names back to atom ids
58	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	/-- The atom id a Lean name reads: the longest id whose `defName` is a prefix of the name
60	    (`dev_traffic_signal_shows` ↦ `dev.traffic_signal`), with the relation aliases spelled out. -/
61	def atomIdOf (name : String) : Option String :=
62	  let n := match name with
63	    | "rel_ahead_in_lane" | "rel_behind_in_lane" => "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane"
64	    | other => other
65	  let cands := atomIds.filter fun id =>
66	    let d := Semantics.defName id
67	    n == d || n.startsWith (d ++ "_")
68	  cands.foldl (fun acc id => match acc with
69	    | none => some id
70	    | some a => if id.length > a.length then some id else some a) none
71	
72	/-- The atom ids a read of `id` depends on: itself, and for a read of a region kind or of a relation
73	    that reads kind membership, the kinds whose masks its verdict follows (a kind's ancestors; a
74	    lane relation's lane kind; an entrance's line kinds, stop line and crosswalk). No source
75	    declares an abstract kind: a read of one depends on the kinds refining it directly, and no read
76	    depends on an abstract ancestor. -/
77	def kindDependencies (id : String) : List String :=
78	  let kinds (ks : List StructureKind) := (ks.filter (!·.isAbstract)).map fun k => s!"st.{k}"
79	  let ofKind (k : StructureKind) :=
80	    if k.isAbstract then kinds (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k))
81	    else kinds (k :: k.ancestors)
82	  match id with
83	  | "rel.ahead_behind_in_lane" => id :: ofKind .lane
84	  | "st.entrance_of" => id :: ofKind .stopLine ++ ofKind .crosswalk
85	  | _ =>
86	    if id.startsWith "st." then
87	      match StructureKind.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
88	      | some k => ofKind k
89	      | none => [id]
90	    else [id]
91	
92	/-- The atom ids a formula list reads, through atoms and primitives (a concept call is expanded first). -/
93	def formulaAtomIds (fs : List Formula) : List String :=
94	  ((fs.flatMap Formula.atoms).flatMap fun n =>
95	    if n.startsWith "prim_" then (Primitives.reads n).filterMap atomIdOf
96	    else (atomIdOf n).toList).flatMap kindDependencies |>.eraseDups
97	
98	/-- The atom ids a rule reads, through its atoms, its primitives and, transitively, the
99	    rules it composes. -/
100	def Rule.atomIds (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : List String :=
101	  let rec go (fuel : Nat) (seen : List String) (r : Rule) : List String :=
102	    match fuel with
103	    | 0 => formulaAtomIds r.formulas
104	    | fuel + 1 =>
105	      formulaAtomIds r.formulas ++ (r.composes.flatMap fun id =>
106	        if seen.contains id then [] else
107	        match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
108	        | some r' => go fuel (id :: seen) r'
109	        | none => [])
110	  (go rules.length [r.id] r).eraseDups
111	
112	inductive Support
113	  | supported
114	  | partially (absent : List String)      -- some atoms unobserved: verdicts may be unknown
115	  | unsupported (absent : List String)    -- the obligation reads nothing the source observes
116	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
117	
118	def Support.tag : Support → String
119	  | .supported => "supported"
120	  | .partially _ => "partial"
121	  | .unsupported _ => "unsupported"
122	def Support.absent : Support → List String
123	  | .supported => []
124	  | .partially a | .unsupported a => a
125	
126	/-- Support from syntax alone, closed over the rules a rule composes. Unsupported when every atom
127	    the obligation reads is absent (the rule could never decide), or a binder's class can never be
128	    established, or a composed rule is itself unsupported. -/
129	def support (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (m : Manifest) : Support :=
130	  -- the clock is every source's: a window over time reads it, and no manifest declares it absent
131	  let absentOf (fs : List Formula) : List String × Nat :=
132	    let ids := (formulaAtomIds fs).filter (· != "kin.time")
133	    (ids.filter fun id => !m.observes id, ids.length)
134	  let (oblAbsent, oblTotal) := absentOf [r.obligation]
135	  let clsDead := r.binders.any fun b =>
136	    let (a, n) := absentOf [b.cls]
137	    n > 0 && a.length == n
138	  let composedDead := (r.composes.filterMap fun id => rules.find? (·.id == id)).any fun r' =>
139	    let (a, n) := absentOf [r'.obligation]
140	    n > 0 && a.length == n
141	  let allAbsent := (Rule.atomIds rules r).filter fun id => !m.observes id
142	  if allAbsent.isEmpty then .supported
143	  else if clsDead || composedDead || (oblTotal > 0 && oblAbsent.length == oblTotal) then .unsupported allAbsent
144	  else .partially allAbsent

147	-- Masking: a scene as the source would have produced it

149	namespace Mask
150	def user (id : String) (u : RoadUser) : RoadUser :=

152	  | "ru.subject" => u
153	  | "ru.occupant_count" => { u with occupants := none }
154	  | "ru.rider_posture" => { u with posture := {} }

156	  | "kin.heading" => { u with kin := { u.kin with heading := none } }
157	  | "kin.velocity" => { u with kin := { u.kin with velocity := none } }
158	  | "kin.speed" => { u with kin := { u.kin with speed := none } }
159	  | "kin.accel_longitudinal" => { u with kin := { u.kin with accelLongitudinal := none } }
160	  | "kin.yaw_rate" => { u with kin := { u.kin with yawRate := none } }
161	  | "kin.extent" => { u with kin := { u.kin with extent := none } }
162	  | "kin.steer_angle" => { u with kin := { u.kin with steerAngle := none } }
163	  | "kin.path_length" => { u with kin := { u.kin with pathLength := none } }
164	  | "kin.engine_running" => { u with kin := { u.kin with engineRunning := none } }
165	  | "kin.parking_brake" => { u with kin := { u.kin with parkingBrake := none } }
166	  | "kin.gear" => { u with kin := { u.kin with gear := none } }
167	  | "kin.throttle" => { u with kin := { u.kin with throttle := none } }
168	  | "kin.service_brake" => { u with kin := { u.kin with serviceBrake := none } }
169	  | "sig.turn_indicator" => { u with sig := { u.sig with turnIndicator := none } }
170	  | "sig.brake_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with brakeLamp := none } }
171	  | "sig.hazard" => { u with sig := { u.sig with hazard := none } }
172	  | "sig.headlamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with headlamp := none } }
173	  | "sig.position_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with positionLamp := none } }
174	  | "sig.warning_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with warningLamps := none } }
175	  | "sig.siren" => { u with sig := { u.sig with siren := none } }
176	  | "sig.horn" => { u with sig := { u.sig with horn := none } }
177	  | "sig.hand_signal" => { u with sig := { u.sig with handSignal := none } }
178	  | "ru.aggregate" => { u with classes := none }   -- the source classifies nothing: every member unknown
179	  | "sig.door_open" => { u with sig := { u.sig with doorsOpen := none } }
180	  | "sig.compression_brake" => { u with sig := { u.sig with compressionBrake := none } }
181	  | "st.sight_along_way" => { u with sightAlongWay := none }
182	  | _ =>
183	    -- a class atom: the source cannot tell this class, so no user is known to have or lack it,
184	    -- nor the attribute the class carries
185	    match RoadUserClass.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
186	    | some k =>
187	      let u := { u with classes := u.classes.map (·.filter (· != k)), unobservedClasses := k :: u.unobservedClasses }
188	      match k with
189	      | .emergencyVehicle => { u with emergencyKind := none }
190	      | .officialVehicle => { u with officialKind := none }
191	      | .electricBicycle => { u with eBikeClass := none }
192	      | _ => u
193	    | none => u
194	
195	def structure' (id : String) (st : Structure) : Option Structure :=
196	  match id with
197	  | "st.lane_direction" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with direction := none } }
198	  | "st.lane_adjacency" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l =>
199	      { l with leftNeighbour := none, rightNeighbour := none, ordinalFromLeft := none, countInDirection := none } }
200	  | "st.lane_connectivity" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with leadsTo := none } }
201	  | "st.lane_enters" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with entersIntersection := none } }
202	  | "st.lane_marking" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with markingLeft := none, markingRight := none } }

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- The measured overlap of the projections on the car's heading at step k (the rider offset 8 − 2k m

def measuredOverlap (k : Nat) : Q :=

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the source does not observe the gap between bodies. Core
    computes `rel.surface_gap` from the footprints when it is not supplied, so masking the atom alone
    leaves it decided: here the source does not observe the rider's extent (its footprint), and
    supplies the overlap of the projections as a measured relation, which Core can then not compute.
    The gap between the bodies is neither supplied nor computable. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  Build.pad
    (Build.trace nSteps t0 (Units.milliseconds 500) fun k t =>
      Build.withRelations
        (Build.scene t (some 1)
          [ car k (cm 280)
          , Build.withKin (rider k .bicycle (m 1)) fun kn => { kn with extent := none } ]
          oneLaneRoad [])
        [ Build.relation 1 2 fun r => { r with longitudinalOverlap := some (measuredOverlap k) } ])
    (Units.seconds 12) (Units.seconds 1) (Units.milliseconds 500)
